message: イタリアン・トレビアン

name: Synn
message: 「Sigh... I'm starving...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hey, that's my line」

name: Synn
message: 「I let my guard down since it's the start of the month. I can't believe I forgot to make curry」

name: Misa
message: 「Teehee. Failing as Student Council President just because you can't handle a little hunger, are we?」

name: Synn
message: 「What does that have to do with being president?」

name: Misa
message: 「Your endurance is being tested. Even I skipped lunch today, you know」

name: Synn
message: 「I see... So you're enduring the hunger pangs too, Misa」

name: Misa
message: 「N-No, I'm not! Don't lump me in with you!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「At times like this, why don't we all go out for an extravagant meal together?」

name: Misa
message: 「Were you even listening to what I just said!?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Well, I just felt so sorry for the Vice President」

name: Synn
message: 「Why?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Not having any friends to eat lunch with\s06」

name: Misa
message: 「I DO have friends!! Skipping lunch wasn't about that--」

name: Synn
message: 「Then what on earth is going on?」

name: Misa
message: 「U-Ugh... Well... Um...」

name: Misa
message: 「...I-I'm on a diet」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Excuse me, server!」

name: Misa
message: 「Hey, listen to me!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Hahaha, Lolotte. Lunch here is self-service with meal tickets」

name: Waitress
message: 「Did somebody call, nya?」

name: Synn
message: 「H-Huh?」

name: Waitress
message: 「What would you like to order, nyan?」

name: Synn
message: 「N-Nyan?」

name: Waitress
message: 「Hurry up and decide, nyan!!」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Whaat!?」

name: Waitress
message: 「If you're just window shopping, we'll charge you a fine of a hundred trillion yen, nyan♪」

name: Synn
message: 「Eek!!」

name: Waitress
message: 「It's only natural when we're this busy, nya」

name: Synn
message: 「N-No way. And I just got my allowance for this month, too...」

name: Waitress
message: 「Well, what's it gonna be, nyan?」

name: Synn
message: 「Ugh... uuugh... then... guh, daikon sprout ramen」

name: Waitress
message: 「Daikon sprout ramen? We don't have any food to feed broke losers, nyan」

name: Synn
message: 「Wha!!」

name: Waitress
message: 「What about that woman over there, nyan?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Something like tonkatsu ramen would suit you quite well!!」

name: Misa
message: 「I-I couldn't eat something so greasy and fattening...!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「What a picky eater you are. Very well, I shall have it. Make it a large!」

name: Waitress
message: 「Fried stuff is a pain to make, so pick something else off the menu, nya」

name: Lolotte
message: 「How utterly lazy! Have you no sense of hospitality whatsoever?」

name: Waitress
message: 「I recommend the daikon sprout ramen since it's super easy to make, nyan」

name: Synn
message: 「What am I even supposed to pick...」

name: Misa
message: 「Hey!! I've been keeping quiet and listening to you this whole time, and now!!」

name: Waitress
message: 「I'm under orders to kick out hysterical customers, nya」

name: Misa
message: 「Who are you calling hysterical--!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Now, now, Misa. I get how you feel, but just calm down」

name: Misa
message: 「What a terribly rude waitress.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Indeed. Even if it isn't hand-breaded and fried, surely they could at least whip up some tonkatsu.」

name: Misa
message: 「How they make it isn't the issue!! This girl is making fools of us!」

name: Waitress
message: 「If you don't have any business here, you should hurry up and leave, nya.」

name: Misa
message: 「Grrr! You there, what is your name? Tell me!」

name: Waitress
message: 「There is zero need for me to give you my name, nya.」

name: Misa
message: 「What did you say?!」

name: Synn
message: 「Pasta.」

name: Misa
message: 「Hey, Sakura-kun! Why are you leisurely ordering food right now?!」

name: Synn
message: 「No, it's written on her name tag.」

name: Pasta
message: 「You've got a pretty sharp head on your shoulders for someone so scrawny, nya.」

name: Misa
message: 「E-Even I noticed that much...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Don't sweat it, Vice President. For the record, I noticed it too.」

name: Misa
message: 「Nngh...!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Still, Pasta, is it? What a delicious-sounding name~~ *slurp*」

name: Pasta
message: 「Nya-what?!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「How should I cook you up, I wonder? Should I boil you to an andante?」

name: Pasta
message: 「W-What are you planning to do to Pasta, nya?! Please spare me any mentaiko-based sauces, that's gross, nya!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It's not like I'm actually going to catch you and eat you.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Though it seems there's someone else here ready to bite your head off.」

name: Misa
message: 「*Huff, huff*」

name: Synn
message: 「Now, now!」

name: Misa
message: 「Where do you think you're touching in the middle of all this chaos, you pervert!」

name: Synn
message: 「I said it's a misunderstanding!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「And so, please hurry up and bring out three bowls of tonkatsu ramen」

name: Misa
message: 「I don't need any!」

name: Pasta
message: 「If you get in Pasta's way any more than this, I'll sue you for interfering with business, nya」

name: Misa
message: 「The wonderful Prier is ruined because of you, too. I'm the one who's gonna sue you!」

name: Pasta
message: 「Do whatever you want, nyan」

name: Synn
message: 「Good grief...」

name: Misa
message: 「Sigh... I wasted so much energy...」

name: Synn
message: 「Isn't that fine? You'll lose weight」

name: Misa
message: 「It's pointless unless I'm burning calories!!」

name: Synn
message: 「I think they're both the same thing, though...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Even so, my stomach growls for bang bang chicken. It cannot be helped. Allow me to lend a hand here」

name: Synn
message: 「Ooh!?」

name: Misa
message: 「N-No way, 'Eat me'...!?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Actually, I had a bento with me」

name: Misa
message: 「Eat that from the start then!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Eh? Of course, I intended to eat this 'as well'」

name: Synn
message: 「It's a tiered bento box...」

name: Misa
message: 「Just how big of an eater are you...」
T-This dream-come-true situation of being offered a tiered bento box!!
It came true so effortlessly....

name: Synn
message: 「I-Is this what they call the Student Council President's privilege...!?」

name: Misa
message: 「Huh?」

name: Synn
message: 「Thank you for the food~♪」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Please, go ahead and eat. It's Grandpa's homemade special lunch♪」

name: Synn
message: 「Delicious!」

name: Misa
message: 「Ugh... *gulp*」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Heehee. You too, Vice President, please don't hold back and eat plenty♪」

name: Misa
message: 「T-thank you for the meal...\s03」

name: Synn
message: 「Delicious!」
A meal eaten together with everyone tasted happier than the ramen I always eat.
